newsitem.title: FINLAND: OIP TO ISSUE 100 MLN FIVE-YEAR BOND.
newsitem.headline: OIP TO ISSUE 100 MLN FIVE-YEAR BOND.

text.p: Finnish OKO-Investointipankki Oy (OIP), part of Finnish cooperative banking group OKOBANK, said on Friday it will issue a 100 million markka five-year bond with a 4.50 percent coupon.
The issue price will be variable. Interest will be paid annually on February 25 and the principal will be redeemed in full on February 25, 2002, OIP said in a statement.
The subscription period will run from February 25 to June 25, 1997.
A bourse listing will be sought for the bond after the subscription period, it said.
